# ARTEL

> ARTEL is a game QA tool. Add the SDK to a Unity game and an AI agent plays it directly, runs scenarios, and keeps evidence (screenshots, logs, the step timeline) at the moment a failure happens. You can use the hosted service or self-host it with Docker.

ARTEL은 게임 QA 도구입니다. Unity 게임에 SDK를 연결하면 에이전트가 직접 조작하며 시나리오를 검증하고, 실패한 순간의 증거를 남깁니다.

## Pages

- [Home](https://artel.kr/en): what ARTEL does and who it is for
- [SDK](https://artel.kr/en/sdk): install the Unity SDK and connect a game
- [Self-hosting](https://artel.kr/en/self-hosting): run ARTEL on your own server with Docker
- [Self-hosting: Install script](https://artel.kr/en/self-hosting/install-script): install ARTEL with one command
- [Self-hosting: Docker Compose](https://artel.kr/en/self-hosting/docker-compose): run ARTEL with Docker Compose
- [Self-hosting: Plain docker run](https://artel.kr/en/self-hosting/docker): start each ARTEL container with docker run
- [How it works](https://artel.kr/en/how-it-works): how the agent plays, judges, and records a run
